fig_fang.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium-quality PHOTO-REAL 3D PRODUCT RENDER of a physical 1/7 scale painted PVC anime figurine of FANG (Arknights), one single figurine, upright portrait 1:2 canvas, true transparent background. Reference 1 is ONLY character identity and exact costume/colors. Reference 2 is ONLY framing, sculpted pedestal thickness, upper-left light direction and product camera; DO NOT copy its placeholder character or chibi proportions.
This must unmistakably look like a REAL SOLID MINIATURE SCULPTURE photographed in a studio: rounded sculpted face with painted anime eyes, real three-dimensional nose and cheeks, visible thickness to bangs and separate flowing hair locks, cast occlusion shadows under hair and collar, thick coat hems and sculpted folds, physical seams on PVC boots, soft broad specular highlights on molded plastic, reflected edge light on hair and cloth, realistic soft volumetric shading, no flat black outlines. Clearly visible side surfaces on torso, arms, legs and clothing, not a printed cardboard cutout. NO illustration, NO cel shading, NO painterly brushwork. Character face remains faithful stylized anime, not a human actor.
Character: blue-gray tied hair and long blue horse tail, tall pointed horse ears, blue eyes, black long Rhodes Island open jacket with gray sleeves and teal short dress, black thigh-high socks, brown boots, long black spear with metallic silver spearhead. Same identity as reference, normal approximately seven-head human proportions (NOT CHIBI). Relaxed balanced standing pose with weight on back leg; spear held diagonally but close to body so its FULL TIP and entire shaft stay inside the tall canvas. Costume colors and identity unchanged.
Green rarity PRIZE EDITION: simple round dark gray physically thick display base with two small gray stones, no elaborate scene/effects. Boots visibly CONTACT pedestal; small natural contact shadows on the pedestal itself.
CONSISTENT SERIES CAMERA: 3/4 front view with about 25-degree yaw, camera gently looking downward about 8 degrees. Full body and full base in frame. Base elliptical top surface visibly foreshortened, base centered near bottom, ample safe margins all sides, object roughly 86% of canvas height and 75% width. Key large softbox at upper-left-front, modest thin rim light at rear right. Crisp high-resolution commercial scale figure product photography, neutral color rendering, rich soft local shading.
BACKGROUND must be genuinely FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including all space between limbs and spear; no studio wall, no gradient, no floor, no external drop shadow, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard texture. Only the figurine and its attached pedestal. No text, no watermark, no frame.

Do not crop any object. Keep normal seven-head proportions. Maintain the same three-quarter product camera and physical volume. Clean the silhouette: remove any blue/chroma-key fringing and stray detached pixels outside the figurine, use a thin neutral white edge highlight, not an electric blue halo.
